[DE|Local] rbb24 Der Tag in Berlin und Brandenburg (Berlin) (Mon 19:17): Sondierung gehen weiter | BM-Wahl Strausberg | Studienstart Medizin-Uni
item.description:
Originally published Mon 12 Oct 2026 19:17 IDT.
Linke, Grüne und SPD arbeiten daran, eine Regierung für Berlin auf die Beine zu stellen. Doch noch wird – auch öffentlich – gestritten. Außerdem: Bürgermeister-Stichwahl in Strausberg; Studienstart Medizinische Uni Cottbus; Start für zweites Gleis zwischen Cottbus und Lübbenau.   "DER TAG in Berlin und Brandenburg" – kompakt und informativ mit dem Neuesten aus Ihrer Region. Abonnieren und hören können Sie den Podcast in ARD Sounds. "DER TAG" gibt es auch im Vorabendprogramm im rbb-Fernsehen, immer montags bis freitags 18 Uhr.

item.title: [EN|In-Depth] BBC Global News Podcast (Mon 18:04): French supermarkets say fridges targeted in cyberattack
item.description:
Originally published Mon 12 Oct 2026 18:04 IDT.

Major French supermarket chains have reported being hit by a cyberattack that caused their refrigerators to defrost. More than 150 Intermarché stores were targeted, along with almost 100 Coopérative U outlets. The hackers may have also hit other major chains in France and neighbouring countries.

Also: Saudi airspace remains heavily disrupted, as Yemen's Houthis continue a barrage of missile attacks. President Zelensky says Washington has to make Russia respect the energy ceasefire announced by President Trump, after Russian strikes hit Ukrainian power plants overnight. Thousands have rallied in Delhi for what they call a March for Democracy, aimed at removing the head of India's electoral commission, following fraud allegations. Why AI data centres could be a major issue for voters in the US midterms. Pakistan detains the chief minister of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province after sacking him and his government and declaring a local emergency. We speak to the president of Microsoft about the dangers of AI going rogue... and the case of a Qing period porcelain bowl found mysteriously smashed inside the British Museum.

The Global News Podcast brings you the breaking news you need to hear, as it happens. Listen for the latest headlines and current affairs from around the world. Politics, economics, climate, business, technology, health – we cover it all with expert analysis and insight.
